customReplacement.reason: Reuses project PDFViewer and Button; adds page-note behavior within established gray/accent reading surface.

contract.purpose: Reader turns a saved article or PDF into a focused place to read, annotate, revisit, and discuss it.
contract.purposeSource: Site Health reader dossier purposeContract and PROJECT_STATUS.md
contract.canonicalPurpose: Reader turns a saved article or PDF into a focused place to read, annotate, revisit, and discuss it.
contract.audience: People who save serious reading and need to retain useful notes beside the source.
contract.job: Create, revisit, edit and delete account PDF page notes without exposing another account’s saved notes or drafts.
contract.thesis: Keep the document central and show only supported reading tools; expose AI chat as an explicit optional action.
contract.system: Existing charcoal shell and Button palette, gray hierarchy, responsive stacked mobile panels and retained 400px desktop tools panel. PDF backgrounds change behind the unchanged document artwork.
contract.signature: The document stays visible at narrow widths while the tools panel moves below it.
contract.risk: The existing fixed-width tools panel hid the document on phones; stacking preserves reachable document controls. AI remains an explicit entry without automatic chat mounting.

findings: Three existing border-accent warnings identify loading spinners, not cards.
Before mobile fixture showed PDF hidden by the fixed-width sidebar; stacked layout restores document and control access.

evidence.reviewMethod: Real Hono article handlers and Drizzle persistence in isolated SQLite, with synthetic authentication/PDF bytes. Built browser verifies page-note create/edit/delete/reload, failed PUT retry, and delayed PUT/GET delivery across same-SPA Alice-to-Bob visibility refresh. Parent reviewed source and 390/1440 screenshots with no blocking finding. External requests blocked; no hosted upload/provider/deploy. Whole-array note API does not merge concurrent editors.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner authorized bounded account PDF controls and page-note completion. No provider calls, hosted uploads or deployment; hosted qualification remains #55.
